blocks.content: Consistent revision and conceptual clarity are the ultimate keys to cracking competitive examinations.

items: Pay strict attention to negative marking by avoiding unverified guesses on tricky options.
Direct factual questions and statement-based matching options are regularly framed from summary points.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Prioritize high-weightage core concepts and frequently asked revision topics.
Consistently practice previous years' question papers to build exam-tempo and time management skills.
Focus on clarity of fundamentals to effortlessly solve multi-statement and assertion-reasoning questions.
